title: "Verification and declaration"

{{< include _includes/preset-help-declaration.qmd >}}

**Declaration values are mandatory requirements for a declaration, not technical model limits.** PEExcel can calculate different assumptions. Document whether a variant is exploratory or prepared for klimaaktiv verification.

## What may vary, and what applies to verification?

| Topic | Free modelling | klimaaktiv declaration |
|---|---|---|
| PV LCA | Can be modelled | Not included in the klimaaktiv assessment method |
| Hourly conversion factors | Custom assumptions possible | Use prescribed declaration values |
| User electricity | Alternative assumptions possible | Use prescribed declaration values |
| Internal heat gains | Alternative assumptions possible | Use prescribed declaration values |

These examples illustrate the principle. Specific values and fields are documented in the **tool version in use** and its supporting material; this page does not maintain a second value table.

## Preparing verification

1. **Version and objective:** Document tool version, quality level and project boundary.
2. **Evidence for inputs:** Record sources for areas, energy certificate, weather, PV, mobility and component data.
3. **Declaration values:** Identify differing model assumptions and apply verification requirements.
4. **Calculate and check:** Review results and AUDIT; address errors and notices.
5. **Assessment boundary:** Distinguish physical flows, virtual context contributions and assessed emissions.
6. **Save documentation:** Keep variant, export, calculation state and verification documents together.

AUDIT supports quality assurance. This website performs no separate eligibility check. Official contacts in the [documentation](download.qmd) can address verification questions.

## Verification sheets {#excel-nachweise}

**Where in PEExcel?** [PEQ]{.excel-menu .darkred} (positive energy district), [PEQ+M]{.excel-menu .orange} (PED with mobility) and [KN PEQ]{.excel-menu .teal} (climate-neutral PED).

::: {.excel-path}
**Ribbon:** klimaaktiv PEQ → Nachweise → PEQ im Betrieb / PEQ mit Mobilität / Klimaneutrales PEQ
:::

The sheets summarise project value, target or budget, and difference for each boundary. PEQ covers operation; PEQ+M adds motorised private transport; KN PEQ additionally covers life-cycle GHG assessment. Outputs support verification documentation but do not replace professional review.

## Quality assurance {#qualitaetssicherung}

For verification, align entered areas and use shares with project documents. Also check calculated net floor areas, volumes and floor-area ratio. Document the sources so model and submitted project version can be traced.

**Where in PEExcel?** [AUDIT]{.excel-menu .red} (quality assurance).

AUDIT supports **automated plausibility checks**, showing deviations from predefined declaration values for the current variant. A deviation need not be a modelling error; review it for verification and justify it in the audit report. Justification alone does not replace professional acceptance of a deviation.

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** Save project/variant name, tool version and calculation state. Check data sources and boundaries; address AUDIT notices individually. Apply mandatory requirements or clarify deviations professionally. File results and export with verification documentation.
:::

Source: [Training, slides 4 and 35](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=35) (German).
